1128.unvetted: Original not online and the only description is the editor's note. Re-read Klinckowstroem vol. 1 p.155-156 n.1 (IA lecomtedefersen01klingoog): 'lettre en chiffre (non dechiffree) du roi de Suede Gustave III au comte de Fersen, datee de Stockholm, le 28 fevrier 1792', printed 1877, so a note, not an archive description. Fersen answered on 1 Apr 1792 (no. CLXVIII, minute) saying he had received it, so he read it at the time; no text of it printed in vol. 1-2, nor in the English Diary and Correspondence (IA diarycorrespond00fers). Tried: Riksarkivet/Stafsund digitisation (none found), Uppsala Gustav III archive (is the king's own, not Fersen's), Price 1999 Hist. J. (not opened, paywalled). Would unblock: Riksarkivet Fersen papers image or finding aid via Chrome, and Proschwitz, Gustave III par ses lettres (1986).

Needs the HHStA Span. Varia Fasz. 39 leaf or a Vienna finding aid saying 'Chiffre'.
